en: Colorized street view of a grand boulevard lined with stately 19th‑century buildings and trees, with hills in the background. A prominent stone mansion with ornate façade and balcony stands on the right behind an iron fence. Pedestrians walk along the wide unpaved road. The front text at the top reads in German and Hungarian: "Kronstadt. — Brassó." and on the right "Rudolfring. — Rezső-körút." The reverse side shows handwritten correspondence in German, Hungarian postal markings and the Hungarian word for postcard "Levelező lap", addressed to Frl. Mausi Stenzel in Hermannstadt, Siebenbürgen.
